result.rationale: poll_feed.rb calls `i.content.scrub` and `i.title` unconditionally on every feed item (diff shows `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` inside `rss.items.each`). SimpleRSS returns nil for missing elements, so a single item without content would raise NoMethodError, aborting the loop; combined with `sidekiq_options retry: false`, remaining items are skipped until the feed changes. The mechanism is grounded in the diff, though nil-return behavior of the external gem is assumed, so moderate confidence.

judged_text: A single feed item missing `content` (or `title`) crashes the whole import loop in poll_feed.rb:32 — SimpleRSS returns nil for absent elements so `i.content.scrub` raises NoMethodError, aborting the loop so all subsequent items are never imported, and `retry: false` means the same items are skipped forever on the hourly run
